source: Authenticated in-app browser, published application before local changes
method: Wall time around reload plus waiting until Master heading and table are visible; includes browser automation overhead. Not Navigation Timing, LCP, SQL time or a percentile study. Resource Timing is unavailable in the browser tool's read-only evaluation scope.
otherRoutes: Consolidado and Repro navigations initially exposed Suspense placeholders; their partial navigation durations were discarded instead of reporting them as data-ready times. No authenticated browser after-change measurement exists because the changes have not been deployed.
